# Retro — title edge cases

## Proposed kit deltas

1. e.g. foo bar baz is the working title of a delta that has no sentence end at all
2. **Unclosed bold xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx→ tail words after the arrow follow here
3. BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB→ more words after the arrow. Second sentence stays in the evidence.
4. Plain sentence one is short. The remainder of the line is the evidence of this item.
5. See e.g. The Rules document for background and other long reasons
6. use vim. then more steps follow in the same item
7. **Bold title with colon:** body text
